solver.no_fallback_policy: If PyChrono is unavailable, stop with an environment report.

rocket.stage3_proxy_nozzle_reference_note: Thies reports nozzle clearance as distance from nozzle end to landing pad. The Stage 3A proxy does not include CAD nozzle coordinates, so the reported 0.570 m parking clearance is stored as a transparent reference height from the proxy lower-leg/base plane to the nozzle-end point.

legs.equivalent_guidance_model: Stage 3A tripod proxy: inclined ChLinkMatePrismatic main-leg guide, nonlinear compression-only TSDA main buffer, and two spherical-end elastic TSDA diagonal braces per footpad. Main buffer law is replaced by Thies 2022 Figure 4/5 digitized table curves.

stage3_tripod_proxy.source: Thies 2022 Table 4 dimensions; tangential brace separation is an explicit geometry-closure assumption.

mechanism_elements_per_leg.main_guide: ChLinkMatePrismatic along the deployed main-leg axis
mechanism_elements_per_leg.main_buffer: ChLinkTSDA from B attachment to footpad center; nonlinear compression-only force law
mechanism_elements_per_leg.long_brace: ChLinkTSDA spherical-end axial brace from T attachment to footpad center
mechanism_elements_per_leg.short_brace: ChLinkTSDA spherical-end axial brace from K attachment to footpad center

nonlinear_buffer_law.source: Thies 2022 Figures 4 and 5 digitized from supplied PDF page 7.
nonlinear_buffer_law.table_interface_note: Spring and damper curves are digitized from raster PDF figures; hard stop remains only a numerical guard beyond the digitized stroke range.

digitization.source_pdf: 海上平台火箭回收文献/P3_Thies_2022.pdf
digitization.source_markdown: 海上平台火箭回收文献/P3_Thies_2022.md
digitization.method: PyMuPDF page rendering, manual axis calibration, color-threshold curve extraction, and linear resampling.
digitization.force_sign_convention: Thies plots compression as negative force/displacement/velocity; Chrono table stores compression and resisting force as positive values.
digitization.hard_stop_note: The hard-stop terms are not digitized paper data; they are a numerical guard outside the digitized range.

contact.source: Thies Table 6 plus Li 2025 contact/friction values where Thies has no numeric contact material table.

published_values: rocket mass, inertia, height, base diameter, CG and touchdown velocity from Thies 2022
leg count, leg length, leg angle and attachment heights from Thies 2022
damper linear stiffness/damping and reference stroke/force from Thies 2022
reported nozzle clearance 0.570 m from Thies 2022 Table 8
contact stiffness/damping radius and dynamic friction from Li 2025
tripod attachment heights T/K/B and strut lengths from Thies 2022 Table 4
nonlinear buffer base stiffness/damping from Thies 2022 Table 10
main-buffer nonlinear force-stroke and force-velocity curves digitized from Thies 2022 Figures 4 and 5
explicit_assumptions: four leg azimuths are symmetric at 45/135/225/315 deg because exact azimuths are not published
footpad mass is a transparent engineering placeholder until CAD or paper data is available
nozzle end location is represented by a Stage 3A proxy reference offset because CAD nozzle coordinates are not published
stage 1 uses a TSDA strut plus contact footpad model, not a full Adams-equivalent linkage
stage 1 constrains each footpad with a vertical prismatic mate instead of explicit tripod-link hinges
Chrono SMC Young modulus is set as an explicit contact-material assumption because Li reports contact stiffness/damping, not elastic modulus
Stage 3A uses axial TSDA links as spherical-end elastic braces; brace mass/inertia are not yet modeled as separate CAD rods.
Tangential separation of the two diagonal brace attachment points is set to 1.5 m because the supplied papers do not publish the full 3D CAD hinge coordinates.
The nonlinear buffer hard-stop stiffness/damping are numerical assumptions until a hydraulic or hydropneumatic force-stroke table is available.
Post-touchdown lock is currently a diagnostic stability flag and does not yet actuate a physical locking clamp.
Digitized Thies buffer law still uses a numerical hard-stop guard beyond the visible Figure 4 stroke range.
